## PR description ### [Bugfix] Fix request batching regression on Ming-flash-omni ImageGen [labels: ready] PLEASE FILL IN THE PR DESCRIPTION HERE. ## Purpose Fix regression imported in #4079 Resolves #4839 After some bridge func runs, diffusion_prompt is a `list[dict]`. In `vllm_omni/engine/orchestrator.py`, Both of the two submit paths reject a list for diffusion stages, however, the unwrap `diffusion_prompt = diffusion_prompt[0]` get covered only when `already_submitted` is true. This PR fixed the above regression, as well as a trivial DiffusionOutput issue in Ming Image-gen pipeline . ## Test Plan ```bash vllm serve Jonathan1909/Ming-flash-omni-2.0 --omni \ --deploy-config vllm_omni/deploy/ming_flash_omni_image.yaml \ --port 8091 ``` Send a single request with ```bash curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8091/v1/chat/completions \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{ "model": "Jonathan1909/Ming-flash-omni-2.0", "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Please draw a cute cat."}], "modalities": ["image"] }' | jq -r '.choices[0].message.content[0].image_url.url | split(",")[1]' | base64 -d > ming_imagegen.png ``` **vLLM Version:** 0.24.0 **vLLM-Omni Commit:** 5c51782c ## Test Result **BEFORE SUBMITTING:** read [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-omni/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) and run the [precheck-pr skill](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-omni/blob/main/.claude/skills/precheck-pr/SKILL.md) with the code agent for a self-check against project conventions.
